enabled.description: Enable amd-smi configuration (no actual daemon; controls config file presence).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for amd-smi logs; must be one of: error, warn, info, debug.

default_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for synchronous operations (e.g., metric retrieval).

default_device.description: Default GPU device index when none specified in CLI arguments (0-based).

syslog_enabled.description: Whether to send error messages to syslog in addition to stderr.

include_devices.description: List of PCI bus IDs to include for amd-smi operations (omit all to use all detectable devices). Each item is a list of single PCI IDs for grouping (typically 1 per item).

exclude_devices.description: List of PCI bus IDs to exclude from amd-smi operations. Each item is a list of single PCI IDs for grouping.

rocm_lib_path.description: Custom path to librccl.so or ROCm SMI library (e.g., /opt/rocm/lib). Empty uses system default.
